hook_line: TEEN CHESS MASTER RISKS US SCHOLARSHIP OVER VISA

hook_stat.sub: Trying every day for a US visa appointment since losing his passport in Bratislava in June 2026

stats.label: Grandmaster norms banked, with one final norm needed for the Grandmaster title
In family loans over two years to fund his European playing circuit

diaspora_bullets: His full scholarship is to the University of Texas at Rio Grande Valley in Brownsville, Texas
He has already deferred admission from Fall 2026 to Spring 2027
key_entities: University of Texas at Rio Grande Valley
news_summary: Md Imran, a 17-year-old International Master from Andhra Pradesh, holds a full scholarship to the University of Texas at Rio Grande Valley, but his approved F-1 visa was in the passport he lost in Bratislava in June 2026 and he has spent four months unable to secure a US visa appointment.
payoff: If he cannot secure the visa before UTRGV's January 19, 2027 orientation, he risks losing the scholarship altogether.
